title: SLR / single-direction spacer stacks and integral stop

parts.name: 01_FrontBarrel
parts.role: Single front loading: G2 onto rear shoulder, cup spacer, G1, front retainer. Integral rear socket receives middle pilot.

parts.name: 02_MiddleBarrel
parts.role: Two complete internal cells load from front; rear stop is integral, with 60 degree entry chamfer and 1.5 mm flat aperture land.

parts.name: 03_RearBarrel
parts.role: Rear loading of complete G7-spacer-G8 cell-spacer-G9-spacer-G10 stack; common rear retainer loads G7 front shoulder.

parts.name: 04_G3G4_InternalCell
parts.role: Bench: seat and locally bond G4, then G3 from front. Whole cell enters middle barrel from front after G5/G6 cell.

parts.name: 05_G5G6_InternalCell
parts.role: Bench: independently seat/bond G5 from front and G6 from rear. Whole cell enters middle barrel first, from front.

parts.name: 06_G8_InternalCell
parts.role: Thin OD100 cell for cemented G8 only; 4.1 mm radial wall. Rear-loaded glass locally bonded; stack preload bypasses glass through metal ends.

parts.name: 07_FrontCupSpacer
parts.role: Robust tapered spacer between G1 and G2; 8 mm radial width at both ends, 3.27 mm minimum normal wall.

parts.name: 08_G7G8_Spacer
parts.role: Rectangular 3.1 mm radial spacer from G7 rear land to G8 cell front metal end.

parts.name: 09_G8G9_Spacer
parts.role: Rectangular spacer: 2.3 mm axial by 3 mm radial; presses G8 cell rear metal end and G9 added peripheral flat.

parts.name: 10_G9G10_CupSpacer
parts.role: Cylindrical OD110 cup spacer; 8 to 5 mm radial wall with tapered bore; G9 rear land to G10 front contact.

parts.name: 11_FrontRetainer
parts.role: Front retainer clamps G1-spacer-G2 stack against barrel rear shoulder.

parts.name: 12_MiddleCellRetainer
parts.role: Front common retainer presses only internal cell metal flange; integral stop shoulder reacts the load.

parts.name: 13_RearRetainer
parts.role: Common rear retainer clamps G10-spacers-G9-G8 metal cell-G7 chain against front shoulder.

blank_revisions.change: G3 front bevel outside r47, original OD96 retained
G8 rear bevel outside r41.5, OD91.4 retained
G9 OD92 to100, front flat r47..50 at Z198.8

radial_features.kind: Housing joint M4 tap drill, before aperture platform
Three local G8 bonding access holes

assembly_scheme: Three enclosing pilot/socket barrels; front and rear single-direction spacer stacks; two middle internal cells; G8-only thin rear cell.

bench: G3/G4: front-load G4, then G3; individually seat and locally bond
G5/G6: load G5 from front and G6 from rear; individually seat and locally bond
G8: load cemented group from rear into thin cell and locally bond
front: From object side: G2, tapered spacer, G1, front retainer
middle: From object side: whole G5/G6 cell first to integral stop shoulder
From same side: whole G3/G4 cell next, contacting G5/G6 cell at Z98
Fit front common retainer: all axial load acts on cell metal, not on stop aperture edge
rear: From image side: G7, long spacer, preassembled G8 thin cell, short spacer, G9, cup spacer, G10, rear retainer
final: Fit middle front pilot into front barrel socket and fasten
Fit rear socket over middle rear pilot and fasten; all internal frames are enclosed

warnings: Nominal editable demo; no optical aperture check, real thread definition, preload, stress/thermal or production tolerance verification.
New reference blanks contain two peripheral bevels and one OD extension; original optical files unchanged.
Remaining local glass bonding: G3/G4, G5/G6 and G8 within cells. Front G1/G2 and rear G7/G9/G10 use spacer compression.
